title: Abacco Education ERP
cardDescription: A multi-school ERP covering students, teachers, attendance, timetables, exams, results, fees and reports — with role-based dashboards and white-label Android apps.
overview: Abacco Education ERP is a multi-school management platform run by a Super Admin. Each school's data is separated inside one shared codebase, and admins, teachers, students and parents each get their own dashboard. The same frontend is packaged as school-branded Android apps using Capacitor.
problem: Schools were running admissions, attendance, fees and results on paper and spreadsheets. Every school wanted its own branding and app, but building a separate system for each one wasn't practical.
solution: One multi-tenant platform: a Super Admin manages many schools, each school sees only its own data through role-based permissions, and the same React/Vite frontend is shipped as separate branded Android apps (Fazeelah EMS, Waseela EMS, Abacco School App).
result: Schools manage their daily operations from one system, parents get fee reminders by SMS/WhatsApp, and new branded school apps can be produced from the shared codebase instead of being built from scratch.
features: Super Admin multi-school management with school-specific branding
Classes & sections, student and teacher registration
Fee management with payment gateway integration
Automated fee reminders by SMS / WhatsApp
Role-specific dashboards for admins, teachers, students and parents
contributions: Built React frontend pages for school administration workflows
Implemented multi-school (multi-tenant) functionality and data separation
Worked on authentication and role-based user access
Integrated frontend with REST APIs and Prisma/PostgreSQL services
Packaged the web app as Android apps with Capacitor and Android Studio
Tested Android builds and API integrations, supported deployment

challenges.challenge: Keeping each school's data strictly separate in a shared database.
challenges.solution: Scoped every query and API route by school/tenant ID and enforced it through role-based middleware.

challenges.challenge: Shipping several branded Android apps from one codebase.
challenges.solution: Used Capacitor with per-school configuration for app name, logo and application ID, all pointing to the shared backend.
